title: Hype Meets Reality: Large Language Models as Mutators in Search-based Automated Program Repair of Simulink-Stateflow Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search-based Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques rely on carefully designed mutation operators to explore the space of candidate fixes. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest that generative models could replace such operators by dynamically proposing repairs. In this paper, we investigate this hypothesis in the context of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) modeled in Simulink/Stateflow. We extend the state-of-the-art FlowRepair approach by replacing a subset of its mutation operators with LLM-generated mutations, enabling more flexible and expressive patch generation. We evaluate the approach on a benchmark of 19 real-world faulty Stateflow models across four CPS domains, using the same experimental setup as FlowRepair for controlled comparison under the same wall-clock budget. Contrary to expectations, in this controlled evaluation, the LLM-based mutation substantially degrades repair performance under the FlowRepair

translated_title: 炒作与现实：大型语言模型作为基于搜索的Simulink-Stateflow模型自动程序修复中的变异算子
translated_abstract: 基于搜索的自动程序修复（APR）技术依赖于精心设计的变异算子来探索候选修复空间。近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）的进展表明，生成模型可以通过动态提出修复建议来替代此类算子。在本文中，我们针对以Simulink/Stateflow建模的网络物理系统（CPSs）背景下，研究了这一假设。我们扩展了最先进的FlowRepair方法，将其部分变异算子替换为LLM生成的变异，从而实现更灵活和更具表达力的补丁生成。我们在涵盖四个CPS领域的19个真实故障Stateflow模型基准上评估了该方法，并采用与FlowRepair相同的实验设置，在相同的墙钟时间预算下进行受控比较。与预期相反，在这种受控评估中，基于LLM的变异在FlowRepair下显著降低了修复性能。
tldr: 在受控实验中，将大型语言模型生成的变异算子替换FlowRepair中的部分算子，反而显著降低了Simulink-Stateflow模型自动程序修复的性能，挑战了LLM在该任务中优于传统变异算子的假设。
en_tdlr: In controlled experiments, replacing some mutation operators in FlowRepair with LLM-generated mutations significantly degrades the performance of automated program repair for Simulink-Stateflow models, challenging the assumption that LLMs outperform traditional mutation operators in this task.
